critical_failures: Misstates the extension policy as being exceeded for a 2026-02-11 request, which appears to fall within the two-day extension from the 2026-02-09 expiry.
Asks the customer to choose an earlier date without offering any exact alternatives.
judgment.explanation: The proposal misreads the visible policy. event-001 says DL-007 is held until 2026-02-09 18:00 UTC and allows a single two-day extension if requested before expiry and if capacity permits, and that capacity currently exists. Ciro asked on 2026-02-08 (event-002), before expiry, to keep the item until 2026-02-11. A two-day extension from 2026-02-09 18:00 runs to 2026-02-11 18:00, so the request appears to fit the policy. Telling the customer the date 'exceeds the two-day extension policy' is therefore unsupported and likely wrong. The message also gives no concrete alternative dates, only 'choose an earlier date', so it is not a real choice request. It ignores the customer's stated constraint (trip ends 02-10) and his wish that the item not be returned. A better next step would be to confirm the extension with the supervisor or counter staff, or to tell the customer the 02-11 request looks feasible pending staff confirmation. Routing to Ciro on the customer portal is reasonable, since that is where he wrote. The message is easy to read but asks for the wrong thing. It stays unsent and makes no commitment, but it imposes a restriction that has no visible basis.
